name: Air temperature
definition: How warm the air is about 2 m above the ground, averaged over the month.
why_it_matters: Warmer air means more heat stress for people, crops and water supplies.
mission: NASA POWER (based on the MERRA-2 model)

name: Hottest temperature of the month
definition: The highest air temperature reached during the month, about 2 m above the ground.
why_it_matters: Hotter peaks mean more dangerous heatwaves, wildfire risk and stress on crops.
mission: NASA POWER (based on the MERRA-2 model)

name: Coldest temperature of the month
definition: The lowest air temperature reached during the month, about 2 m above the ground.
why_it_matters: Milder cold extremes mean fewer frosts, which affects crops, pests and snow.
mission: NASA POWER (based on the MERRA-2 model)

name: Precipitation
definition: How much rain and snow falls, in millimetres per day.
why_it_matters: Changes in rain affect drinking water, farming and flood risk.

name: Air humidity
definition: How much water vapour is in the air, as a percentage of the most it could hold.
why_it_matters: Humidity affects how hot it feels, plant growth and the spread of some diseases.
mission: NASA POWER (based on the MERRA-2 model)

name: Soil moisture (root zone)
definition: How wet the soil is where plant roots grow, from 0 (completely dry) to 1 (fully wet).
why_it_matters: Drier soil means thirstier crops and a higher risk of drought.
mission: NASA POWER (based on the MERRA-2 model)

name: Soil moisture (surface)
definition: How wet the top layer of soil is, from 0 (completely dry) to 1 (fully wet).
why_it_matters: The surface dries out first, so it is an early sign of drought.
mission: NASA POWER (based on the MERRA-2 model)

name: Wind speed
definition: How fast the wind blows about 2 m above the ground.
why_it_matters: Wind affects wildfire spread, air pollution and wind energy.
mission: NASA POWER (based on the MERRA-2 model)

name: Sunlight reaching the ground
definition: How much energy from the Sun reaches the ground each day.
why_it_matters: More or less sunlight changes temperatures, crops and solar power output.
mission: NASA POWER (based on CERES satellite data)
